# Tender response — Framework agreement for technical property maintenance (JMK-TEK-2026/09)

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid F-Gas qualification (FKAASU, valid until 2028-01-31) covering refrigeration and air-conditioning works. Two completed reference projects meet the value thresholds in Section 3: a kiinteistonhoito and LVI framework agreement for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (five health centres), value EUR 1,650,000, and a school-property LVI maintenance framework for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, value EUR 1,120,000. Both exceed the EUR 500,000 threshold in Section 3.3. Our equity ratio for the most recent financial year is 35.2%, against the 20% threshold in Section 3.4.

## Technical response

**Routine maintenance visits.** A fixed annual visit calendar is proposed for all four properties, with the standard scope of tasks confirmed at each visit through a signed visit report.

**Fault response and standby.** Visakoivu operates a standby arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, with defined response-time commitments.

**Access control and site security.** Personnel will observe the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures at all four properties, including the school and day-care premises during operating hours.

**Statutory electrical inspection.** Carried out by our own personnel under our Sahkourakointioikeudet, class S1.

**Environmental matters.** Managed under our NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system: waste segregation by type, controlled handling of hazardous substances, and spill-prevention measures.

**Occupational safety.** A site-specific occupational safety plan is enclosed, maintained under our NMSB 75310:2018 system (valid to 2026-11-30).

**Building envelope inspection.** Roof, facade and window condition are inspected twice yearly at each property.

**Corrective maintenance response times.** Tiered by fault category, from safety-critical through to non-urgent.

**Personnel qualifications.** Work of this kind is delivered by our own LVI (62), sahko (48) and rakennusautomaatio (18) specialists, supplemented by subcontracted staff holding equivalent trade certificates.

## Commercial terms

We propose the standard cost-of-living index as the price adjustment mechanism. We accept the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level is not met.

## Format

Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year. The tender is submitted as a single PDF file. Prices are exclusive of value-added tax.

## Forms enclosed

Curricula vitae of key personnel; completed Tender Form (Liite 1); completed Reference Form (Liite 2).

## Annex A — Technical specification

Spare-parts availability and standard delivery times are confirmed for the installed building systems. Fire-protection systems — smoke detection, fire dampers and emergency lighting — are maintained on a defined schedule at each property. Lift maintenance is carried out under the applicable statutory periodic inspection regime.

## Annex B — Forms and commercial terms

We accept the retention terms set out in the draft contract.

Visakoivu Oy
